description: Drive the Adafruit NeoTrinkey (SAMD21 USB key with 4 NeoPixels): a real USB-serial driver, a simulated driver, and a 3D visualizer that shows the 4 LEDs as size- and color-coded spheres.

models.short_description: Real NeoTrinkey driver over USB serial (CircuitPython firmware)
3D visualizer for the 4 NeoPixels (size = intensity, color = RGB)
